correctness.rationale: Graph is rigorously defined as C_n Cartesian K_2. The explicit D8 and D11 selected-vertex coverage arguments plus lists of all 9 and 13 outside-neighborhood signatures prove feasible. A self-contained incidence lower bound (d+2)|D|>=2|V| yields 7 and 9 for the cubic prisms. Embedded verify.py reconstructs adjacencies, checks every trace, counts all 14,893 candidate sets of size <=6 for n=8, and reproduces assertions. Computation is a supplement, not replacement for the general lower-bound proof.

originality.rationale: Conjecture 2 of Raza et al. (2021) claims one more vertex is necessary at both n=8 and n=11; the explicit feasible sets plus proved matching lower bound directly contradict it. The nearby proved Theorem 5 supplies only the weaker upper bounds and does not imply either sharp case. Exact and alias searches of primary literature and indexed public research records found no prior correction to these two instances. Residual unindexed-priority risk is stated.
residual_risks: An overlooked older or later corrected paper could already record these two small counterexamples or a stronger exact prism formula; title, alias and indexed searches cannot exclude unindexed work.
No independent scientific audit has yet assessed the graph witnesses or their priority.

value.rationale: The 2021 article formulates a precise open conjecture about locating-total domination in circular prisms, predicting an additional vertex in two residue classes. The two explicit minimum sets refute the two separate exceptional branches already at the smallest identified examples n=8 and n=11. Correcting a published extremal conjecture in two cases is independently motivated and does not rely on unsupported downstream applications.
